verdict.rationale: Glama's Gateway logs every call flowing through it and provides access control and credential management (glama-docs-4, glama-docs-28), implying some visibility into usage, but there is no evidence of a dedicated analytics dashboard showing call volumes, per-user breakdowns, error rates, or cost tracking. Missing for 10: explicit usage/analytics dashboard UI, error-rate reporting, per-user consumption breakdown, cost/billing analytics tied to server/tool usage.
